review_modes.name: Listen
review_modes.description: Play the dialogue line with visual context.

review_modes.name: Echo
review_modes.description: Play the target line, then ask the learner to repeat.

review_modes.name: Produce from visual
review_modes.description: Show the scene/visual cue without model audio first; learner produces the target line.

review_modes.name: Missing line
review_modes.description: Play surrounding lines and ask the learner to fill the missing target line.

review_modes.name: Response cue
review_modes.description: Play the response and ask the learner to infer what they should have said.

review_modes.name: Transfer
review_modes.description: Use the same target function in a new scene.

review_modes.name: Free response
review_modes.description: Accept any natural response that fits the function and scene.

review_modes.name: Choose intention
review_modes.description: Show or play a scene and ask which communicative function the learner-character needs.

review_modes.name: Choose best response
review_modes.description: Show a scene and several plausible responses; learner chooses the line that fits the intention.

review_modes.name: Reject weird response
review_modes.description: Ask the learner to identify a response that is grammatical but wrong or socially odd for the scene.

review_modes.name: AI roleplay unlock
review_modes.description: Use known functions in a constrained live roleplay after the learner has shown basic intention control.
